# Navan — Style Reference

> Aubergine ink on hotel stationery, with an electric-violet boarding pass. Serif headlines in deep plum, Inter Light body copy, a white paper canvas, lavender tiles in place of rules, and one #6307f8 pill rationed to the primary action.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Navan speaks an editorial-fintech product language: a corporate card and travel platform typeset like a travel magazine. The canvas is #ffffff, layered upward through #f8f8fd feature panels, #f1f1f9 quote cards and #e1e2fe lavender prompt tiles, then inverted into #15002c, the aubergine that replaces black for all 160 measured text instances and for the footer. The chromatic budget is one saturated hue, #6307f8 electric violet, permitted on the primary pill, eyebrow links and active states, while #c185e5 and #743899 stay decorative. Typography carries the thesis: Sanomat serif at 400 to 600 for every headline from 30 to 45px, set against Inter at weight 300 for body copy and tracked -2% throughout, so hierarchy comes from family contrast rather than from weight. A 130px Inter 700 stat numeral is the only shout. Shape is a two-word vocabulary of 9999px pills for actions and 12 to 16px corners for containers. Elevation is tonal, with one deep 25px/50px shadow reserved for floating panels. The page reads as a printed itinerary rather than a SaaS dashboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-canvas` | Page canvas, nav bar, persona cards and text on violet or aubergine fills, 85 uses across background and color. It is the stationery every other tone is printed on. |
| Mist Panel | `#f8f8fd` | `--color-mist-panel` | Product feature panels and large section backdrops. This barely-tinted lilac white separates content blocks without a single border line. |
| Fog Card | `#f1f1f9` | `--color-fog-card` | Testimonial quote cards, menu promo cards and illustration wells, 9 uses. It is the workhorse secondary surface, one tonal step deeper than Mist. |
| Frosted Tile | `#f0f0ff` | `--color-frosted-tile` | The large 250×100 hero intent tiles. Its slightly bluer cast than Fog marks a surface as clickable rather than informational. |
| Frosted Chip | `#e1e2fe` | `--color-frosted-chip` | The smaller 163×80 hero prompt tiles and selected-state chips, 7 uses. It is the deepest pastel and the only surface that reads as a tint of the brand violet. |
| Aubergine Ink | `#15002c` | `--color-aubergine-ink` | All headlines and body copy, the demo pill, outline-button borders and the footer, 160+ text uses. This deliberate plum replaces black, so every word carries brand color. |
| Slate Text | `#70708f` | `--color-slate-text` | Secondary descriptions, menu sublabels and supporting metadata, 5 uses. It is a violet-leaning gray that keeps secondary copy inside the aubergine family. |
| Pewter Caption | `#8d8da5` | `--color-pewter-caption` | Captions, legal lines and inactive labels, 10 uses. It is the lightest text that still clears contrast on white. Do not use it for body paragraphs. |
| Iron Rule | `#5a5a72` | `--color-iron-rule` | 1px dividers and input outlines inside the aubergine footer, 3 uses. It is the hairline tuned for the inverted surface only. |
| Steel Border | `#a9a9bc` | `--color-steel-border` | The 1px rules flanking the logo-row label and light-surface separators, 3 uses. It is the system's rare line, used as punctuation rather than structure. |
| Signal Violet | `#6307f8` | `--color-signal-violet` | Get-started pill fill, 2px pill border, eyebrow links in menus and active icons, 20 uses. It is the single saturated hue, so its presence always means "act here." Do not use it for headlines or large backgrounds. |
| Orchid Glow | `#c185e5` | `--color-orchid-glow` | Decorative dots, illustration fills and gradient stops in product art, 11 uses. It adds warmth to imagery. Do not promote it to a button or text color. |
| Amethyst Tile | `#743899` | `--color-amethyst-tile` | The filled 4px-radius icon squares in the mega menu, 6 uses. It is a muted icon ground that stays quieter than Signal Violet. Do not use it as a CTA fill. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Sanomat — editorial serif that carries every headline and gives the product a magazine voice · `--font-sanomat`

- **Substitute:** Newsreader Display at 500, Source Serif 4 (optical size 60) at 500, Crimson Pro at 600. Sanomat draws lighter than its nominal weight: the measured 600 renders like a 500 in most open serifs, so step each substitute down one notch from the number and match the visible stroke.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 30px, 34px, 40px, 42px, 45px
- **Line height:** 1.12 (42px), 1.2 (45px), 1.24 (34px), 1.27 (30px), 1.35 (40px)
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at every size (tracking left at normal)
- **Role:** A serif on a fintech product is the signature move. Ramp, Brex and Concur all headline in grotesks, so Sanomat makes Navan read as hospitality rather than accounting. The weights cluster tightly between 400 and 600 and the face renders light, which keeps headlines authoritative but calm. Its sizes jump from 30 to 40px, a Perfect Fourth step of 1.333, then tighten to 45px for section openers, a near-flat top end that keeps every section headline the same volume.

### Inter — the UI and body workhorse, set light and tracked tight · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter from Google Fonts at the same weights, Geist at 300, DM Sans at 300 with -0.01em extra tracking. Inter renders true to its nominal weight, so no compensation is needed. The 300 body weight must stay 300, because a 400 substitute reads noticeably heavier than the site.
- **Weights:** 300, 400, 500, 600, 700
- **Sizes:** 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 17px, 19px, 20px, 21px, 130px
- **Line height:** 0.92 (130px), 1.32 (19px), 1.4 (15px), 1.43 (14px), 1.46 (13px), 1.5 (16px), 1.58 (12px), 1.88 (17px)
- **Letter spacing:** -0.24px at 12px, -0.26px at 13px, -0.28px at 14px, -0.3px at 15px, -0.32px at 16px, -0.34px at 17px, -0.38px at 19px, -0.6px at 20px, -0.42px at 21px, -2.6px at 130px (a uniform -2% everywhere except the 20px label at -3%)
- **Role:** Weight 300 is the most-used weight on the page at 102 instances. Light body copy against a serif headline is anti-convention for B2B, where 400 is the default, and it lets the serif carry all the gravity. Weight 700 at 77 instances does the structural work in eyebrows, menu titles and the 130px stat numerals, so the system runs on a 300/700 binary with almost nothing between. The body sizes step by 2px (13, 15, 17, 19, 21), a linear ramp rather than a modular one, which keeps UI text dense and even.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 300 | 12px | 1.58 | -0.24px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 400 | 13px | 1.46 | -0.26px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | 400 | 14px | 1.43 | -0.28px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 300 | 15px | 1.4 | -0.3px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 300 | 17px | 1.88 | -0.34px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Inter | 700 | 19px | 1.32 | -0.38px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Sanomat | 400 | 30px | 1.27 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Sanomat | 500 | 40px | 1.35 | 0px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Sanomat | 600 | 45px | 1.2 | 0px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Inter | 700 | 130px | 0.92 | -2.6px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every section headline in Sanomat at 40 to 45px and weight 500 to 600 with 0px tracking — the serif is the brand, and the product reads as a travel publication because of it.
- Use #15002c for all body text, headlines and outline borders — aubergine ink in place of black is non-negotiable, and it tints the whole page violet without spending any chroma.
- Run body copy in Inter weight 300 at 15px with -0.3px tracking — the light weight leaves Sanomat as the only heavy voice on the page.
- Reserve #6307f8 fill for one pill per viewport, at a 9999px radius and 10px 28px padding — rationing is what keeps the violet legible as the call to action.
- Separate sections with tonal surfaces (#ffffff → #f8f8fd → #f1f1f9) and 80px gaps — the system layers paper rather than drawing lines.
- Pair a 9999px radius for anything clickable with 12 to 16px for containers — the two-shape vocabulary tells the eye what is actionable before it reads a label.
- Apply -2% letter spacing to Inter at every size, from -0.24px at 12px to -2.6px at 130px — the uniform tightening keeps the light weight from looking airy.

### Don't

- Don't set headlines in Inter 700 at 45px "for consistency with the UI" — that discards the serif thesis and turns Navan into one more sans-serif fintech page.
- Don't replace #15002c text with #000000 or a neutral #111111 — pure black breaks the aubergine tint, and violet accents then look pasted on.
- Don't fill section backgrounds or cards with #6307f8 — a violet field of 400px or more drowns the 44px pill that depends on being the only saturated object.
- Don't bump body copy to weight 400 or 500 for "readability" at 15px — the gap between Inter 300 and Sanomat 600 is what carries hierarchy, so narrowing it flattens the page.
- Don't add 1px #a9a9bc borders around feature panels or persona cards — lines are reserved for the logo-row label and the footer, and boxing every container turns the magazine into a spreadsheet.
- Don't put the lg shadow `0px 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)` on in-flow cards — it belongs only to elements that float over content, such as the mega menu.
- Don't give buttons an 8px or 12px radius to match the tiles — buttons are 9999px pills; never square them off, or the action layer disappears into the container layer.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**

- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- feature panel: #f8f8fd (Mist Panel)
- secondary surface: #f1f1f9 (Fog Card)
- primary text and inverted surface: #15002c (Aubergine Ink)
- secondary text: #70708f (Slate Text)
- hairline: #a9a9bc (Steel Border)
- primary action: #6307f8 (filled action)

**Color in Data**

Charts use #15002c lines and Slate #70708f axes on #ffffff, with #6307f8 reserved for the single highlighted series or current value and comparison bars drawn as #e1e2fe or #6307f8 at 20% opacity, so the accent stays a marker rather than a flood.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor element with background #6307f8, text #ffffff and a 2px solid #6307f8 border, with border-radius 9999px, padding 10px 28px and height 44px, set in Inter 14px weight 400, line-height 20px, letter-spacing -0.28px, with no shadow. On hover, keep the border and shift the background to transparent with #6307f8 text. Place a second pill directly to its right with an 8px gap, background #15002c, border 2px solid #15002c, text #ffffff and identical metrics, labelled "Request a demo".

2. Build a navigation bar: height 77px, background #ffffff, no border, no shadow, static positioning, content constrained to 1440px with 40px side padding. Left: an 90px-wide black wordmark followed by six links in Inter 14px weight 400, color #15002c, letter-spacing -0.28px, with 40px gaps between links. Right: the violet pill (#6307f8, 9999px radius, 10px 28px padding), an 8px gap, the aubergine pill (#15002c, same metrics), then a "Log In" link in Inter 14px weight 700 #15002c and a 20px round flag at a 50% radius. On hover over a trigger, drop a #ffffff mega-menu sheet with border-radius 0px 0px 40px 40px, shadow 0px 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25) and 40px padding.

3. Build a product feature panel: background #f8f8fd, border-radius 16px, no border, no shadow, a two-column grid. Text column padded 60px: an eyebrow "Navan Travel" in Inter 15px weight 700 #15002c, a 12px gap, a headline "One-Stop Shop" in Sanomat 40px weight 500 line-height 54px #15002c, a 16px gap, a 340px-wide paragraph in Inter 13px weight 300 line-height 19px letter-spacing -0.26px #15002c, a 24px gap, then an outline pill of max-width 410px with a transparent background, 1px solid #15002c border, 9999px radius, 10px 28px padding and Inter 15px weight 400 #15002c. Illustration column: a #f1f1f9 well flush to the panel's right edge holding a #ffffff mock card at a 14px radius with 20px padding.

4. Build a hero section: a two-column layout within 1440px, with 80px top padding. Left column: an h1 in Sanomat 45px weight 600 line-height 54px #15002c across two lines, a 24px gap, a row of two #f0f0ff tiles at 250×100px, then a row of three #e1e2fe tiles at 163×80px, all at a 12px radius with 12px gaps and centred labels in Inter 13px weight 400 #15002c. Below a 32px gap, place a 295px-wide #6307f8 pill (9999px radius, 10px 28px padding, Inter 15px weight 400 #ffffff) and, 16px below, a centred underlined text link "Watch a demo video" in Inter 15px weight 400 #15002c. Right column: a lifestyle photo with border-radius 14px 14px 14px 20px.

**Role:** Sales-led action beside the primary

**Role:** Per-product entry inside feature panels

Hairline-ringed and wide. ### Navigation Bar

**Role:** Static top bar with mega-menus

Static, white and centred. It is 77px tall with a #ffffff background and is not sticky, with the wordmark at the left, six text triggers (Platform, Solutions, Pricing, Resources, Customers, Company) in Inter 14px weight 400 at #15002c, and the two filled pills, a "Log In" link in Inter 14px weight 700 and a flag avatar at 50% radius on the right. There is no border or shadow at rest — the bar dissolves into the canvas and lets the pills carry the colour.

### Mega Menu Panel

**Role:** Product and company directory dropdown

Floating sheet, rounded bottom. It uses a #ffffff background with a 0px 0px 40px 40px radius and the lg shadow `0px 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)`. Its two-column link list sets Inter 14px weight 700 #15002c labels beside 24px Amethyst Tile #743899 icon squares at a 4px radius, and a right-hand promo card in #f1f1f9 at a 14px radius carries a centred heading and a #6307f8 link. The 40px bottom corners are the system outlier — they let the panel drop like a pulled-down shade.

### Announcement Photo Banner

**Role:** Top-of-page product launch strip

Cinematic dark strip. It is a full-bleed starfield photograph with a floating phone mockup on the right, a centred Sanomat 30px weight 400 headline in #ffffff, an Inter 15px weight 300 subline in #ffffff, and a "Learn more" ghost pill at a 9999px radius with a 1px translucent white ring and a #ffffff0d fill (not a system token). It is the only dark imagery above the nav — it proves the serif holds at large sizes on photography.

### Intent Prompt Tile

**Role:** Hero self-selection shortcuts

Soft lavender choice blocks. The large variant is #f0f0ff at 250×100px and the small variant is #e1e2fe at 163×80px. Both use a 12px radius, no border and no shadow, with centred Inter 13px weight 400 labels in #15002c and a 12px gap between tiles. They work as a tonal button grid in place of a form — the visitor picks an intent ("Arrange a team offsite") before meeting a CTA.

### Product Feature Panel

**Role:** One section per product line

Wide tinted slab. It uses a #f8f8fd background, a 16px radius, no border and no shadow, with text on one half and an illustration well in #f1f1f9 bleeding to the panel edge on the other. Each half carries an Inter 15px weight 700 eyebrow, a Sanomat 40px weight 500 headline, Inter 13px weight 300 body copy at #15002c and the outline pill. Sides alternate left and right per product, and panels stack with a 20px gap — tonal layering does all the separation that borders would do elsewhere.

### Persona Card

**Role:** Audience segmentation carousel

Tall white slab. It is #ffffff at 310×458px with a 14px radius, no border and no shadow, padded 0px 28px 24px 28px (normalized from a measured 0 30px 22px 27px), with an image top, an Inter 19px weight 700 title and Inter 16px weight 300 body copy in #15002c. It sits on a #f1f1f9 band so it lifts by contrast alone — a 14px corner keeps it one step sharper than the 16px section panels.

### Testimonial Quote Card

**Role:** Social proof in a scroller

Tinted quote slip. It uses a #f1f1f9 background, a 16px radius, no border and no shadow, with 24px 16px padding at a 430px measured width, and the quote set in Inter 17px weight 400 with a 32px line height in #15002c. The 1.88 leading is the loosest on the site — quotes get magazine pull-quote air instead of the 1.4 UI density.

### Logo Marquee Row

**Role:** Customer credibility strip

Hairline-framed logo band. Its centred label, "Trusted by thousands of companies", is set in Inter 19px weight 700 at #70708f and flanked by 1px #a9a9bc rules running to the viewport edges. Below it, a single-row horizontal marquee of monochrome customer logos runs at roughly 30px height with 40px gaps. This is one of only two places a visible line appears on a light surface — the rule frames the label like a caption under a photograph.

### Floating Mockup Tile

**Role:** Product UI shown as cut-outs

Scattered white cards. Each is #ffffff with a 14px radius and the subtle shadow, arranged in a staggered collage around the centred section headline. Inner details are mockup-internal: deep indigo #1b005f "Select" buttons, a magenta-to-violet "Redeem" gradient and green approval ticks, none of which are system tokens. The tiles speak the product's own UI vocabulary at reduced scale — show the app as artefacts, not as a framed screenshot.

### Footer

**Role:** Inverted site directory

Aubergine block. It uses a #15002c background with 48px top padding at the full 1920px width, multi-column link lists in Inter 15px weight 300 at #ffffff, Inter 15px weight 700 column heads, and 1px #5a5a72 dividers. The page's only inverted surface — the plum ink that colours every headline becomes the floor the site stands on.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every section headline in Sanomat at 40 to 45px and weight 500 to 600 with 0px tracking — the serif is the brand, and the product reads as a travel publication because of it.
- Use #15002c for all body text, headlines and outline borders — aubergine ink in place of black is non-negotiable, and it tints the whole page violet without spending any chroma.
- Run body copy in Inter weight 300 at 15px with -0.3px tracking — the light weight leaves Sanomat as the only heavy voice on the page.
- Reserve #6307f8 fill for one pill per viewport, at a 9999px radius and 10px 28px padding — rationing is what keeps the violet legible as the call to action.
- Separate sections with tonal surfaces (#ffffff → #f8f8fd → #f1f1f9) and 80px gaps — the system layers paper rather than drawing lines.
- Pair a 9999px radius for anything clickable with 12 to 16px for containers — the two-shape vocabulary tells the eye what is actionable before it reads a label.
- Apply -2% letter spacing to Inter at every size, from -0.24px at 12px to -2.6px at 130px — the uniform tightening keeps the light weight from looking airy.

### Don't

- Don't set headlines in Inter 700 at 45px "for consistency with the UI" — that discards the serif thesis and turns Navan into one more sans-serif fintech page.
- Don't replace #15002c text with #000000 or a neutral #111111 — pure black breaks the aubergine tint, and violet accents then look pasted on.
- Don't fill section backgrounds or cards with #6307f8 — a violet field of 400px or more drowns the 44px pill that depends on being the only saturated object.
- Don't bump body copy to weight 400 or 500 for "readability" at 15px — the gap between Inter 300 and Sanomat 600 is what carries hierarchy, so narrowing it flattens the page.
- Don't add 1px #a9a9bc borders around feature panels or persona cards — lines are reserved for the logo-row label and the footer, and boxing every container turns the magazine into a spreadsheet.
- Don't put the lg shadow `0px 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)` on in-flow cards — it belongs only to elements that float over content, such as the mega menu.
- Don't give buttons an 8px or 12px radius to match the tiles — buttons are 9999px pills; never square them off, or the action layer disappears into the container layer.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Paper Canvas | `#ffffff` | Page canvas, nav bar, persona cards and the mega-menu sheet |
| 1 | Mist Panel | `#f8f8fd` | Product feature panels and broad section backdrops |
| 2 | Fog Card | `#f1f1f9` | Quote cards, illustration wells and menu promo cards |

## Elevation

- **Mega menu panel and floating dropdowns:** `0px 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)`
- **Floating product mockup tiles and the hero widget card:** `0px 2px 2px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02), 0px 4px 5px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`
- **Small floating badges and pin chips over photography:** `3px 3px 6px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18)`

Everything that sits in the page flow — panels, persona cards, quote cards and tiles — carries no shadow and separates by surface tone alone. Shadow signals "this floats over content", not "this is a card".

## Imagery

Imagery is a three-part mix. The first part is product UI rebuilt as floating white mockup tiles at a 14px radius with the subtle shadow (transaction lists, itineraries, chat, reward balances, a central phone). The second is warm lifestyle photography of travellers in cars and on walkways, cropped with asymmetric corners (14px 14px 14px 20px and 0px 0px 14px 14px) so photos feel torn from an album rather than boxed. The third is simple integration diagrams that link an app icon to partner logos with violet hairlines. Menu icons are solid glyphs on #743899 squares at a 4px radius, and mockup icons are thin line glyphs. Gradients appear only inside imagery, in the magenta-to-violet app icon and the redeem button, and are decorative rather than system tokens. A dark starfield banner opens the page. The narrative is a well-run trip documented as a scrapbook of tickets, receipts and moments.

## Layout

The frame caps at 1440px, with feature content in a narrower centred column and section openers centred above it. Sections follow an 80px rhythm, stretching to 140px around major chapters. The hero is a split: Sanomat headline, intent-tile grid and violet pill on the left, rounded lifestyle photograph on the right. Product sections alternate text-left and text-right inside #f8f8fd panels stacked 20px apart. The customer logo row is a single-line marquee, persona cards run as a four-up carousel, and the floating-mockup collage spreads seven tiles across. The nav is static, not sticky, 77px tall and filled #ffffff, with the logo and six triggers on the left and two pills plus Log In on the right. The footer is a full-width #15002c multi-column directory. At 375px, headlines drop to the 30px heading-sm step, sections gap 40px, and tiles wrap two-up. Density: comfortable.

## Serif Headline Restraint

The discipline is that Sanomat speaks and Inter serves. Every h1, h2 and h3 is the serif at weight 400 to 600 between 30 and 45px with 0px tracking, while Inter stays at 300 for reading and 700 only for eyebrows, labels and the 130px stat numerals. Three things would break it: a sans headline, a serif button label, or a Sanomat weight above 600, which turns the editorial calm into a tabloid. To extend the system, add new headline sizes only on the existing steps (30, 40, 45px) and keep every UI string in Inter. When a page needs more emphasis, increase whitespace to the 140px section gap instead of increasing weight. Treating the family split as non-negotiable is what lets a corporate expense tool read like a travel magazine.

## Aubergine Ink Economy

The page holds one saturated hue but feels violet throughout, because the ink itself is #15002c and the neutrals (#70708f, #8d8da5, #a9a9bc, #5a5a72) all lean toward it. Introducing any warm or true-gray neutral breaks this. A #6b7280 caption or a #e5e7eb divider immediately reads as a foreign component library dropped into the page. Extend the palette by deriving every new neutral from the aubergine axis — mix #15002c into #ffffff to produce tints rather than reaching for a stock gray ramp. New pastels should sit between #f8f8fd and #e1e2fe. The result is a brand colour carried by ink, so #6307f8 can stay rationed to a few square inches per screen.

## Violet Rationing

#6307f8 appears as a fill on exactly one pill per viewport, as text on eyebrow links, and as a 2px border on that same pill, for 20 total placements across a 22-section page. Violet headings, violet section bands, a violet second CTA, or violet chart fills at full opacity would each spend the budget. Every additional violet surface lowers the click-weight of the pill. To add emphasis without spending colour, use the #15002c filled pill, a #e1e2fe tile, or the lavender gradient inside decorative imagery only. When a new status or category needs colour in product mockups, keep it mockup-internal (the #1b005f buttons, green approval ticks) and out of the marketing token set.

## Similar Brands

- **Ramp** — It shares the corporate-card category and the pill-shaped primary CTA, but Ramp headlines in a tight grotesk on a yellow-green accent, where Navan uses a serif and violet.
- **Stripe** — It shares a single saturated violet reserved for actions and navy-plum text in place of black, though Stripe leans on gradient mesh backdrops that Navan confines to imagery.
- **Brex** — It shares floating product-UI tiles arranged as a collage around a centred headline, but Brex runs a dark, sans-serif, high-contrast canvas.
- **Airbnb** — It shares travel lifestyle photography and soft 12 to 16px card corners, while Navan adds a serif voice and a stricter one-hue budget.
- **Mercury** — It shares the editorial serif-over-sans pairing applied to a finance product, though Mercury sets body copy at 400 and uses near-monochrome neutrals with no lavender surfaces.
